entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I need to return this VeloBand Cadence Sensor. This is absolutely unacceptable. I've been trying to get this handled for over a week!
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Mark Sterling. Order number is VF88602. You guys sent it to me 20 days ago and now I'm stuck with it because your company can't keep its website running!

Okay, I have your account pulled up, Mr. Sterling. I see the delivery date was December 15th. I understand you'd like to make a return. Just so I can properly document this, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?

It's an 'I don't want it' matter! I tried to return this on day nine! Day nine! I went to your website, and I got a constant **website error**. Your whole return portal **system was down** and I **couldn't print** the label! I want this processed now or I want to speak to your manager.
I understand your frustration, and I sincerely apologize for the trouble with our site. There's no need to escalate this; I can definitely help you. Let me check our system logs for that timeframe.
You better check it. I took a **screenshot** of the error page. I'm one step away from posting it everywhere. This is the worst customer service I've ever dealt with.

Sir, I can confirm we had a known service outage that day that affected our returns portal. That was completely our fault, and I am very sorry you were impacted by that. Let me review the return policy for your VeloBand Cadence Sensor.

Okay, I've checked the policy. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor falls under our standard 90-day return policy. So even with the delay caused by our system, you are well within the window for a full refund. I can approve this return for you immediately.
So you're finally going to process it? Are you sure?

Yes, absolutely. I have just processed the return authorization. The shipping label has been sent to your email on file. And Mr. Sterling, I see you're a VIP member with us. For the significant inconvenience our website caused you, I've also added a $50 credit to your VeloFit account for any future purchase. We truly value your business.
Oh. A $50 credit? Well... okay. That's... thank you. I appreciate you taking care of that. The website problem was just a complete nightmare.
I completely understand, and I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you, Diana.
You're very welcome, Mr. Sterling. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
